title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at $63,694 with fear and greed at 29 as hashrate climbs to 889.6 EH/s, showing miners remain committed despite the sentiment slump. Mempool sits at 77,072 transactions with fees at just 2 sat/vB, pointing to steady but low-urgency activity.

Overnight, Asia session delivered minimal price movement in the narrow range. Block height now stands at 962,271.

Watch for a push above $64,000 or a retest of $63,000 support through the next session.
